scientific_integrity: Finite exact enumerations and full combinatorial acyclic matching have been reproduced by the included standalone script; independent validation and a complete literature census are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact homotopy and rational representation are proven for the specified twelve-arc right Cayley digraph, not all Cayley orientations or larger dihedral groups.
The integral homology module is not classified as a group-ring lattice.
Full text of the 2020 Cayley directed-forest thesis could not be inspected; an equivalent older calculation cannot be entirely ruled out.
title: Four four-spheres and the full left-symmetry character of an \(S_3\) directed-forest complex
